mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift capital from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points from prior month signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) from prior month indicate broad consumer demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST and RSAFS both decline, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 indicates manufacturing sector contraction that lowers corporate profit margins and future earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1500.0 thousand units signals strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through higher corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 1500.0, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI inflation rate exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation that triggers Federal Reserve rate hikes, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations to produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) from prior month indicate labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), the Federal Reserve's policy shift increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.02.
